description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys implementation, specifically testing the generateRequest functionality within the Rialto media key session context. It defines a test fixture class and three test cases to verify successful request generation, failure due to non-existent session, and failure due to session API errors.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysGenerateRequestTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, setting up media key session for testing generateRequest behavior.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysGenerateRequestTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media keys and key session for testing.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysGenerateRequestTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up media keys after tests.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying that generateRequest succeeds under normal conditions.

methods.name: SessionDoesNotExistFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that generateRequest fails when the session does not exist.

methods.name: SessionFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying that generateRequest fails when the session API reports an error.
